starter_questions: Where can I see how many people entered and left?
What GPU does the hotel scene need?

setup_guide.introduction: Start the simulated hotel lobby to follow guests through four camera views. You can watch a crossing and see which entrance or exit it adds to.

sample.title: Live hotel simulation
sample.description: Watch guests queue at reception and leave through two exits.
sample.expected_output: Live camera views, guest tracks, and arrival and departure counts by door.

fields.label: Output folder
fields.description: Save the latest guest counts here.

run_guidance.on_start: I’ll prepare the simulated lobby and connect its four cameras so crossings can be counted by door.
run_guidance.web_ui_ready: Open Hotel lobby live to watch a crossing and compare it with the count for that door.
run_guidance.output_ready: Open the output folder and check the observation time alongside the saved entry and exit counts.

web_ui.title: Hotel lobby live
web_ui.description: Watch four live camera views and see how many guests cross each door.
